instruction: Add HSTS for one year including subdomains.
Set X-Content-Type-Options and X-Frame-Options globally for all responses.
Add a strict Content-Security-Policy that only allows same-origin scripts.
Set a Referrer-Policy to limit leaking of full URLs to other origins.
Disable the server version banner in responses.
Add Permissions-Policy to disable camera, microphone and geolocation.
Prevent MIME sniffing and block framing on all responses including errors.
Enable HSTS only after ensuring the whole site is HTTPS, with preload.
Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy and Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy for isolation.
Allow scripts and styles from a CDN in the CSP.
Remove the X-Powered-By header from proxied responses.
Add cache-control no-store to authenticated API responses.
Set security headers only on HTML responses, not on static assets.
Add a report-only CSP to test violations without blocking.
Reject requests without HTTPS by returning a 444 for plain HTTP after migration.
Force HTTPS redirect and keep the original request path.
Set X-XSS-Protection to the modern safe value.
Apply a CSP that allows Google Analytics while blocking everything else third-party.
Block framing only on sensitive pages while allowing embedding elsewhere.
Set all common security headers in one server block for a static site.
